title.zh: 水的循环 · 一滴水的旅行
title.en: The Water Cycle · One Drop’s Journey

desc.zh: 太阳晒海、水汽上升成云、雨落回山、河流入海：水在海洋、空气和陆地之间不断流动，但总量不变。
desc.en: The Sun warms the sea, vapour rises into cloud, rain falls on the hills and rivers run to the sea: water moves between ocean, air and land, but the total stays the same.
